generate_regnet_widths_depths: generate per stage widths and depths from RegNet parameters w_a, w_0, w_m, and depth d
generate_regnet_full_from_cfg: generate per stage widths, depths, strides, bot_muls, and group_ws from the global RegNet config
convert_regnet_cfg_to_anynet: convert the global RegNet config to AnyNet config format by mapping all stage parameters
build_regnet_model: build a RegNet model instance by calling get_params and initializing the AnyNet base class
compute_regnet_complexity: compute the model complexity of a RegNet using the AnyNet complexity method with params
